name: Flatland Cougar Femur
summary: Across Mulgore, flatland cougars stalk the plains, and Maur Raincaller needs one of their bones. A Flatland Cougar Femur is part of the remedy he seeks for a venomous bite.

sections.title: A Remedy for a Venomous Bite
sections.body:
Flatland cougars are among Mulgore's most dangerous hunters. They vanish into dry brush, then spring upon their prey. Hunters use their pelts and claws for leatherworking and trophies. Their heavy bones also have a place in local medicine.

Maur Raincaller of Bloodhoof Village bears a venomous wound from Mazzranache, a monstrous pink strider. He urgently needs a cougar femur and parts from other local beasts. Crushed or boiled, the bone yields what he needs for an antitoxin poultice to draw fever and necrotic venom from the festering bite.

faq.q: What is the Flatland Cougar Femur used for?
faq.answer: Maur Raincaller in Bloodhoof Village needs the femur for an urgent remedy. The notorious plainstrider Mazzranache bit him, and he needs the bone and marrow to prepare an antitoxin before its virulent venom kills him.

faq.q: Where do you obtain a Flatland Cougar Femur?
faq.answer: You can find Flatland Cougar Femurs on flatland cougars roaming Mulgore's central and southern plains. They prowl near hillsides and in the tall grasses around Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Why would Maur Raincaller need a cougar bone specifically?
faq.answer: Tauren herbalists and shamans use the dense bones and marrow of predatory animals in traditional salves and tinctures. They believe Mulgore's strongest predators provide the restorative base needed to neutralize potent toxins.

Maur Raincaller lives in Bloodhoof Village. After wandering the plains, he crossed paths with Mazzranache, a legendary strider his grandfather once fought. Maur barely escaped with an infected, venomous bite to the shoulder.

angles.text: For the tauren of Mulgore, hunting flatland cougars tests your vigilance and provides vital materials for traditional plains remedies.
As a hunter, you need sharp eyes to track flatland cougars through Mulgore's swaying brush. The hunt tests your skill at bringing down a fellow predator cleanly.
